name: K2 Infragen Ltd.
summary: K2 Infragen Ltd. is an integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company primarily focused on infrastructure development in India. The company provides end-to-end turnkey construction services, specializing in power engineering and project engineering. Its core activities encompass the design, procurement, and execution of various infrastructure projects, including roads, railways, bridges, water supply schemes, civil construction, power transmission and distribution, and renewable energy initiatives. K2 Infragen Ltd. targets both government and private sector clients within India, with significant operations across states such as Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Haryana, Gujarat, Punjab, and Delhi. The company also engages in the trading of construction materials.
